# Ny Indikator 2b

Ny Indikator 2b is a revised quality indicator within the Danish national ADHD database, designed to replace the older [[indikator-2b|Indikator 2b]] [^src1]. It measures the proportion of 6- to 17-year-olds for whom a professional school observation, a structured teacher interview, or a school statement has been carried out no later than 120 days after the start of an ADHD assessment [^src1]. The indicator was created after the steering group ("Styregruppen") reviewed the existing Indikator 2b and split it into two new indicators with updated definitions, which have been through a hearing process and are expected to be implemented within the coming months [^src1].

The revision reflects a broader push in the ADHD assessment system to better match actual clinical practice. Rather than requiring a professional school observation in every case, the new indicator explicitly allows for gradation: in less complex cases, and for older children, a teacher interview or a school statement can be sufficient instead of a full school observation [^src1]. This flexibility is intended to let clinicians do more in complex cases and less in simpler ones, an approach the steering group expects will produce better goal attainment than the rigid definitions of the old indicator [^src1].

Ny Indikator 2b is also explicitly aligned with clinical guidance: its formulation follows the DMPG guideline for ADHD, which states that information about a child's or young person's everyday life in an institution or school setting should be obtained [^src1]. Within the wider ADHD database report covering the period 01.04.2024–31.03.2025, this revision sits alongside a parallel change to Indikator 3, both driven by criticism that the original indicators did not reflect real-world clinical practice and produced substantial regional variation and underachievement against the 90% national target.

## Mentions

- Page 22: "Ny Indikator 2b: Andelen af 6-17-årige, hvor der er foretaget professionel skoleobservation, struktureret lærerinterview eller skoleudtalelse senest 120 dage efter start af ADHD-udredning." [^src1]
- Page 22: "Det er dog ikke nødvendigt i alle sager at der laves en professionel skoleobservation. Det kan i mindre komplekse sager og hos ældre børn være sufficient med lærerinterview eller skoleudtalelse i stedet." [^src1]

## Claims

**Procedural change**
- Styregruppen har arbejdet med revision af Indikator 2b, som bliver delt i to nye indikatorer med nye definitioner, som har været i høring og forventes implementerede indenfor de kommende måneder[^src1] (indikator-2b, ny-indikator-2b)

**Methodological**
- Ny Indikator 2b måler andelen af 6-17-årige, hvor der er foretaget professionel skoleobservation, struktureret lærerinterview eller skoleudtalelse senest 120 dage efter start af ADHD-udredning[^src1] (ny-indikator-2b)

**Clinical standard**
- Det er ikke nødvendigt i alle sager at der laves en professionel skoleobservation; det kan i mindre komplekse sager og hos ældre børn være sufficient med lærerinterview eller skoleudtalelse i stedet[^src1] (ny-indikator-2b)

**Clinical rationale**
- De nye indikatorer giver mulighed for at graduere indsatserne i udredningsforløbene således at man i mere komplekse sager kan gøre mere og i mindre komplekse sager mindre[^src1] (ny-indikator-2b, ny-indikator-3)
- De nye indikatorer afspejler i højere grad den aktuelle kliniske praksis, hvilket forhåbentlig vil medføre bedre målopfyldelse[^src1] (ny-indikator-2b, ny-indikator-3)
